## TASK COMMANDS — call these tools as native MCP tools (server `bakin-jessica`)

```bash
# log progress (mandatory at every major step)
bakin-jessica.bakin_exec_tasks_log_progress taskId=t-fix-2 message="<what you did or are doing>"
# complete / block
bakin-jessica.bakin_exec_tasks_complete taskId=t-fix-2 summary="<what you accomplished>"
bakin-jessica.bakin_exec_tasks_block taskId=t-fix-2 reason="<what went wrong>"
# subtask + dependency chain (then stop — you'll be re-dispatched)
bakin-jessica.bakin_exec_tasks_create title="<subtask>" assignee="<agent>" description="<brief>" parentId=t-fix-2
bakin-jessica.bakin_exec_tasks_set_dependency taskId=t-fix-2 dependsOn="<other-task-id>"
# your task details
bakin-jessica.bakin_exec_tasks_get taskId=t-fix-2
# execution tools — full reference: "Bakin Execution Tools" in your AGENTS.md
bakin-jessica.bakin_exec_assets_save taskId=t-fix-2 type=<images|text|video|audio|plans|data|other> filePath="<path>" description="<what it is>"
bakin-jessica.bakin_exec_images_recommend surface=instagram-feed-portrait objective="<goal>"
bakin-jessica.bakin_exec_images_generate taskId=t-fix-2 prompt="<text>" surface=instagram-feed-portrait provider=auto
bakin-jessica.bakin_exec_check_gates taskId=t-fix-2
bakin-jessica.bakin_exec_post_channel channel="<name>" content="<message>" taskId=t-fix-2

# Project tools (this task is part of a project)
bakin-jessica.bakin_exec_projects_get projectId="proj-9"
bakin-jessica.bakin_exec_projects_mark_item projectId="proj-9" taskItemId="<itemId>" checked=true
bakin-jessica.bakin_exec_projects_add_item projectId="proj-9" title="<item title>"
```

Tool reference + dependency pattern: "Bakin Execution Tools" in your AGENTS.md.
